To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the proper integrable system for the N = 2 supersymmetric gauge theory with n f = 1 is XXX SL (2, Z ) spin chain, 2) the proper integrables systems for the N = ( 2, 2 ) supersymmetric gauge theory in 4D with n f = n c and n f = 3 n c are XXX SL (2, Z ) spin chain and SL (3) magnets with twisted boundary conditions, respectively,
the proper integrables systems underlying the N = 2 gauge theories are the twisted XXX SL ( 2 ) spin chain, SL( p ) magnets and spin Calogero systems with several parameters.
the proper integrables for the field theories are twisted XXX SL ( 2 ) spin chain, SL p ( p ≥ 2 ) magnets and degenerate spin Calogero systems.

the N = 2 supersymmetric gauge theories with massive matter, including the UV finite cases, are described by the integrable systems with a proper choice of the underlying symmetry.

the string theory and brane physics can be used as a guide to the proper integrable structures in N = 2 SYM.
